title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook

```{r}

#this one is proposal of "lexical pioneers"

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)

files_path <- "datasets/G_lists_dataset"

csv_files <- list.files(path = files_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

combined_data <- csv_files %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_delim(.x, delim = ";"))

head(combined_data)
str(combined_data)

#so what i want to know is ON lexemes that exhibit most shifting

summary_shifts <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Hist_status == "a") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Shift_status)) %>% 
  group_by(Lexeme) %>%
  summarise(
    total_a       = n(),                              
    n_a_to_e      = sum(Shift_status == "a>e"),   
    n_a_to_a      = sum(Shift_status == "a>a"),      
    n_other       = total_a - n_a_to_e - n_a_to_a,  
    perc_a_to_e   = 100 * n_a_to_e / total_a,
    perc_a_to_a   = 100 * n_a_to_a / total_a
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(perc_a_to_e))

top10_lexemes <- summary_shifts %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Lexeme)


class_dist_top10 <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Lexeme %in% top10_lexemes) %>%  
  filter(Hist_status == "a") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Shift_status)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Class_label)) %>%        
  group_by(Lexeme, Class_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Lexeme) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    perc  = 100 * n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

lexeme_labels <- tibble(
  Lexeme   = c("laana", "loena", "skapa", "ropa ", "proeva", "rosa", "svara", "lika", "baka", "tapa"),
  Lexeme_nice = c("l\u00E5na 'borrow'", "l\u00F8na 'pay, reward'", "skapa 'create'", "ropa 'shout'",
                  "pr\u00F8va 'try'", "rosa 'praise'", "svara 'answer'", "lika 'like'",
                  "baka 'bake'", "tapa 'lose'")
)


class_dist_top10 <- class_dist_top10 %>%
  left_join(
    summary_shifts %>% select(Lexeme, perc_a_to_e),
    by = "Lexeme"
  )

ggplot(
  class_dist_top10,
  aes(x = reorder(Lexeme, -perc_a_to_e),  # order by most a→e
      y = perc,
      fill = Class_label)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = setNames(lexeme_labels$Lexeme_nice, lexeme_labels$Lexeme)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Class label",
    values = c("a" = "#BDBDBD", "e" = "#2F2F2F", "hybrid" = "#0072B2"),
    labels = c("a" = "\"pure\" a", "e" = "\"pure\" e", "hybrid" = "mixed")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Lexeme",
    y = "Percentage of paradigms"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 14)
  )


```
